Durlabh Sunday

Durlabh Sunday: one rare subject, every week

Durlabh means rare, hard to find. Every Sunday Talaash Heritage takes one subject most people have never heard of, from archaeology, linguistics, anthropology, arts, Sanskrit, history or heritage, and studies it properly: a long read here with every source listed, a narrated lecture on YouTube, and short cuts on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn through the week.

Next piece: Sunday 22 November 2026, late morning (IST).

Every claim is checked three times against primary sources or standard scholarly works before it is published. Spotted an error? Write to talaashheritage@gmail.com and we will correct it with a note.
